dialogue.text: I told you I'd call. I'm looking at New York on the map from Saarbrücken. Central Park is FULL of Pokémon.
Are you walking past PokéStops? Tell me you're walking past PokéStops.
That's my little brother. Send me a screenshot of the Empire State gym. I need to know who holds it.
The subway?! Underground! No GPS! I didn't raise you to miss spawns. Well, Mom did. Fine. Love you. Bye.
